shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md; find .agents -type f | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && sed -n 1,80p references/package-routing.md; echo ------; rg -n -i -C3 "navigation|AsideHeader|table|DataGrid" references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,150p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat rules 2>/dev/null; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat src/* index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls src __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui

for p in navigation table; do echo "== $p"; npm view @gravity-ui/$p version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -30; done; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @bem-react/classname lodash @tanstack/react-table 2>&1 | tail -15; npm install -D @types/lodash 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -A20 '"dependencies"' package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -30

grep -A6 '"dependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json; npm ls @tanstack/react-table; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/*; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md
npm uninstall @tanstack/react-table 2>&1 | tail -2; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs; sed -n 25,200p $D/INDEX.md | cut -c1-260; ls -R $D | head -60
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs; rg -n -i "reorder|group|expand|useRowSelectionFixedHandler|getGroupedRowModel|dnd" $D/INDEX.md | cut -c1-200 | head -50

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs; sed -n 284,376p $D/INDEX.md; sed -n 482,508p $D/INDEX.md; rg -n "GroupTitle|getGroupTitle|columnOrder|ColumnReorderingProviderProps" -g '*.d.ts' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build | head -20

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler*.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -l useRowSelectionFixedHandler $T | head; sed -n 1,60p $T/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts; N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs; ls -R $N; sed -n 1,200p $N/INDEX.md | cut -c1-240

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; rg -n -i "style|import|compact|MenuItem\b|href|hideCollapse|collapse" $N/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-220 | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head -3; for i in House Persons ShoppingCart Gear Receipt; do ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/svgo/$i.svg 2>&1 | tail -1; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/svgo | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Receipt|Box)\.svg"

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Receipt|Cubes3|Magnifier|Bars|Box)\.d\.ts$"; sed -n 1,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | cut -c1-200; rg -n "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -5

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n 1,60p $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts; rg -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow|isGrouped|getCanExpand|subRows" $T/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js $T/components/BaseRow/*.js | head -20; cat $T/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -40; cat $T/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -30

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; rg -n -i "reorder|disabled|draggable" $T/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.js $T/components/BaseHeaderCell/*.js $T/components/BaseHeaderCell/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head -30; rg -n "selectionColumn" $T/constants/*.d.ts $T/**/*.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "getRowClassName|className" $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head; rg -n "interface ColumnMeta|declare module" -A12 $T/types/*.d.ts | head -40

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; rg -n "sticky|stickyHeader|getIsGroupHeaderRow|enableColumnReordering|rowClassName|onRowClick|renderGroupHeader" $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts $T/types/*.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,30p $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts; cat $T/constants/selectionColumn.js | head -30; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -5

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n "renderContent" $N/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts $N/components/PageLayout/*.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "__content|__pane" -A6 $N/components/AsideHeader/*.css $N/components/PageLayout/*.css | head -40; rg -n "logo|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton|menuItems|onAsideClick|panelItems" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head; rg -n "interface MenuItem " -A30 $N/components/types.d.ts | head -45; sed -n 1,40p $N/components/Logo/*.d.ts | head -40
N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n "interface LogoProps" -A22 $N/components/types.d.ts; rg -n "renderContent|compact|onChangeCompact" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

rg -n "enableColumnReordering|hideInSettings" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head; sed -n 30,46p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.js
sed -n 1,20p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts; rg -n "types/base" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/index.d.ts

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='src/OrdersTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import {ColumnReorderingProvider, Table, useTable} from '@gravity-ui/table';\nimport type {ColumnDef, Row, RowSelectionState} from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';",
"import {ColumnReorderingProvider, Table, useTable} from '@gravity-ui/table';\nimport type {ColumnDef} from '@gravity-ui/table';\nimport type {Row, RowSelectionState} from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
cat .gitignore; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short | head -3
